labelChirho: synagogue ruler, president of a synagogue
descriptionChirho: The chief official or presiding leader of a Jewish synagogue, responsible for organizing worship services and maintaining order. Singular and plural forms represent the same lexical meaning with only grammatical number variation. Multilingual evidence: spa 'principal de la sinagoga / principales de la sinagoga,' hin 'आराधनालय / सभागृह-अधिकारी / सभागृह-अध्यक्षों,' arb 'رَئيسِ المَجْمَعِ / رُؤَساءُ المَجمَعِ,' kor '회당장/회당장들,' swa 'mkuu wa sinagogi / viongozi wa sinagogi.' Attested in the Synoptic narratives of Jairus and the bent woman (Mark 5:22, Luke 8:49, 13:14).
